newsitem.title: FINLAND: Wary Helsinki ends mixed, focus on forests, FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Wary Helsinki ends mixed, focus on forests, FOMC.

text.p: Shares were mixed on Tuesday with already weak sentiment hit by a profit warning from Metsa- Serla and trade subdued ahead of a key U.S. Fed meeting.
Th HEX index added 0.10 percent to 2,129.31 but decliners outnumbered advancers at 42 to 32. Volume was a slight 222 million markka.
But brokers saw scope for gains if, as widely expected, the Federal Reserve raises its federal funds interest rate by 25 basis-points -- while bearish, such a move would clear the air.
"An increase of one quarter would lift shares. If there is no increase at all, expectations about a bigger rate hike in the future could increase," one broker said.
Another said a rate hike bigger than 0.25 percentage points would send U.S. shares clearly lower, dragging Helsinki.
Some brokers were also confident about forestries, which partly recovered from losses following Metsa-Serla's warning.
"I think the next move in forestries could be upwards. For example UPM looks attractive as it fell sharply but remained above its 95 markka support level," one said.
Nokia, which made some 27 percent of the total volume, ended 2.00 markka up at 196.00, virtually ignoring an earnings warning from U.S. telecoms group AT&T.
